# HOGLgmanova (v0.2.0)

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

This package selects explanatory variables and degrees of polynomial basis functions in GMANOVA model by hierarchical overlapping group Lasso (HOGL).

**cite this package of the latest version:**  
Ohishi, M. (2026). HOGLgmanova: Variable and basis function selections in GMANOVA model. R package version 0.2.0. https://github.com/ohishim/HOGLgmanova

## Installation

You can install and use `HOGLgmanova` like so:

```{r echo=F, message=F, warning=F}
devtools::load_all()
```

```{r install, eval=F}
devtools::install_github("ohishim/HOGLgmanova")
library(HOGLgmanova)
```

## Example

You can get simulation data by `genData()` and implement HOGL estimation by `GMANOVA.HOGL()`.
The simulation data is generated as

```{r data}
n <- 100; p <- 10; k <- 10; q <- 6
Data <- genData(n, p, k, q)
```

You can obtain true trends as 
```{r}
Data$trend
```

Then, HOGL estimation is implemented as 

```{r run}
Y <- Data$Y; A <- Data$A; time.points <- Data$time.points
res <- GMANOVA.HOGL(Y, A, time.points, q)
```

Estimated trends are 
```{r}
res$trend
```

## Reference

1. Ohishi, M., Nagai, I., Oda, R. & Yanagihara, H. (2025). Hierarchical overlapping group Lasso for GMANOVA model. arXiv: [2510.19311](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.19311).
